args.title: Update localhost link in password reset email template
args.body: Issue 4201 reports that the password reset email links to localhost, which is not accessible to users. The current implementation in src/notifications/templates.ts defines the base URL as 'http://localhost:3000', causing emails to contain links that direct to this local address instead of a public facing URL. The change proposes to update the BASE_URL to use the PUBLIC_URL environment variable, allowing it to point to the correct public domain for users receiving the email.
